title: Repurposing — Content Multiplier
summary: One strong piece becomes several — adapt for each platform, not copy-paste.

sections.heading: Orientation — Lesson Start
sections.subtitle: Lesson Start
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **What will you understand?** A **strong piece of content** can become several — **but each platform has its own format** — **no copy-pasting**.
- **Why now?** After editing, you have clearer content. **Repurposing** allows the same idea to reach **more platforms** **without starting from scratch**.
- **After the lesson:** You take one idea, post, or script — **and turn it into 3 different formats**.

sections.heading: Tension — A Familiar Situation
sections.subtitle: A Familiar Situation
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **You take the same long post** and share it on Facebook, LinkedIn, and X — **and the results are weak on all platforms**.
- **This is not Repurposing** — it’s **copy-pasting**. **Each platform** has its own rhythm, length, and tone.
- **AI** helps you extract ideas, summarize, and rephrase — **and you choose** what remains authentic and useful.

sections.heading: Core Idea — Adaptation — No Copying
sections.subtitle: Adaptation — No Copying
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **Repurposing** means the **same core idea** in formats that suit each platform: **short reel**, **LinkedIn post**, **X thread**, **newsletter paragraph**, **story questions**.
- A **single video or long post** can produce: **3 short scripts**, **a professional post**, **5 engagement questions**.
- **AI suggests formats** — **you review:** **Is the tone still you?** **Is the information useful in this format?**
- **Example Prompt:** «**Transform this content into:** **1) a short LinkedIn post 2) 3 short video scripts 3) 5 story questions 4) a newsletter paragraph** — **and make each version suitable for its platform.**»

sections.heading: Comparison — Copying the Same Text or Smart Adaptation?
sections.subtitle: Copying the Same Text or Smart Adaptation?
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Copying the Same Text | Smart Adaptation with AI |
|--------------|---------------|
| **500-word post** on LinkedIn and X — **people skip it**. **One format** **does not fit everywhere** | **Same idea:** **5-tweet thread**, **45-second reel**, **1 story question** — **each serves the platform** |

sections.heading: Glossary — Two Terms for Multiplication
sections.subtitle: Two Terms for Multiplication
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Term | Meaning | Example |
|---------|--------|------|
| **Repurposing** | **Transforming an original piece** into **multiple formats** **with platform adjustments** | **8-minute video → 3 short clips + summary post** |
| **Format Adaptation** | **Changing length, tone, and structure** **based on where it’s published** | **Same advice:** **strong sentence on X** — **story paragraph on LinkedIn** |

sections.heading: Flow Block — From Original to Formats
sections.subtitle: From Original to Formats
sections.contentMarkdown:
1. **Clear original piece** (video/post/script)
2. **AI suggests formats for each platform**
3. **You choose and edit** — **publish with confidence**

sections.heading: Quiz — Quick Confirmation
sections.subtitle: Quick Confirmation
sections.contentMarkdown:
> **Quiz key (unchanged):** correctIndex: 1

**Question:** **You have a 10-minute video** about a marketing tip. **Best Repurposing?**

You share the video link** on all platforms **with the same comment**.**
**You ask AI** for **a short reel + LinkedIn post + 3 story questions** — **and edit each one**.
You copy the first 3 minutes as text on X** **without editing**.**

**Explanation:** **Repurposing = adapting for each platform**. **AI speeds it up** — **the judgment and authenticity are yours**.

sections.heading: Mission — One Idea → 3 Formats
sections.subtitle: One Idea → 3 Formats
sections.contentMarkdown:
**Introduction:** **Multiplying the process** — **not mandatory posting**. **Choose an idea, post, or script** — **turn it into 3 different formats** — **edit what doesn’t sound like you**. **10–20 minutes is enough**.

**Submission:** original · Format 1 (platform + content) · Format 2 · Format 3 · One edit for authenticity

**Evaluation Criteria:**

| Dimension | Weight | Criteria |
|-------|-------|---------|
| 3 Different Formats | 60% | **Each format for a different platform or shape** — **no copying the same text** |
| Your Judgment | 40% | **One edit** **shows you reviewed** **and chose your voice** |

sections.heading: Confidence Close
sections.contentMarkdown:
